from: SECOND-ROUND FIX 2026-08-18, after the V4 review FAILED this on the CATEGORY. The first pass unified viewer/parsers.py and reported done; the reviewer found THREE surviving second implementations in files that never imported squash — bin/perry-state twice (the Tracks header and the pack glossary header) and bin/perry-diagnose once (md_table, which reads the USER's board and OKR). Writing the category-shaped guard then found a FOURTH nobody had named: bin/perry-explain resolved headers with strip_md(c).lower(), a rule that differs from squash on internal whitespace — AND split rows with m.group(1).split('|'), a fifth splitter that does not honour the escape. Neither was reachable by TASK-050's or TASK-067's guards because BOTH were written against a hardcoded file list that did not name that file. THE DIVERGENCE IS REAL, not theoretical: '**Default** rung' lowers to 'default** rung' and matches nothing, so a project that bolded half a header lost the column silently and every track reported no default rung. Fixed at all four sites, header-only — the value normalizers (Status, Outcome, parse_frequency) keep their own rules deliberately, because they normalize what a project WROTE rather than which column it wrote it in, and widening the guard to cover them flags eight correct call sites. tests/test_one_header_rule.py holds the category: no reader builds a lowercased list over a row's cells, every table reader reaches squash, and perry-lint's norm alias is asserted to BE squash so it cannot quietly become a fifth copy. 4/4 mutations red. to: V4 ROUND 3: FAIL. The decisive test the spec demanded — plant a new reader — came back GREEN, which IS the finding. title: When migration encounters a file the user has chmod-ed read-only, should it refuse to touch that file, or migrate it and name the overridden permission in the plan? Today it migrates silently: write_atomic renames over the target, and a rename needs write permission on the directory, not on the file.
answer: Migrate and name the override; do not refuse. Reasoning recorded because the row was minted for it: refusing would block a whole migration for a reason unrelated to shape, and migration is the one road ADR-004 gives an undeclared project — a refusal there is the wall with no door that this project rejects everywhere else. The override is also reversible: the restore point carries the file's original bytes, verified under TASK-079. The 'at least name it' half of the ADR-004 posture is already satisfied by what shipped in PR #6, and TASK-115 added the guard that keeps that wording an observation rather than advice. The read-only bit stays a signal Perry reports and does not act on.
